From the arcade

Minesweeper

Read the clues. Mark the mines. Clear thirty safe squares.

Play Minesweeper →

How to play

  1. Click a covered square to reveal it. The number counts mines in its eight surrounding squares. Empty areas open together.
  2. Think a square contains a mine? Click “Place flags”, then click that square. Click a flag again to remove it. Switch back to “Reveal squares” to keep playing.
  3. Reveal all 30 safe squares to win. Opening a mine ends the round. Flags are reminders; they do not prove that a square is safe.
  4. “Restart board” repeats the current layout. “Try another board” cycles through three practice layouts.

Each board starts with a safe opening. Some choices may require a guess. All controls work with a mouse or a tap.
